en: Morning dew on grass is liquid water that condensed from invisible water vapor in the cool night air.
A sliced apple turning brown is a chemical change caused by oxygen in the air reacting with fruit enzymes.
Seawater is a homogeneous mixture where solid salt is completely dissolved in liquid water, making it look clear.
Ice melting into liquid water under the tropical sun is a physical change because the H2O molecules remain identical.
Clay soil holds more water than sandy soil because its tiny particles pack tightly to slow down drainage.
The visible white mist above a hot spring consists of tiny liquid water droplets formed when hot water vapor cools.
Muddy typhoon floodwater is a heterogeneous mixture because solid soil particles are temporarily suspended in liquid water before settling.
Rust forming on iron roofs during the rainy season is a chemical change where iron reacts with water and oxygen.
Abaca fibers make strong ropes because the natural material possesses high tensile strength and resists breaking when pulled.
Crushing dry leaves into small pieces for compost is a physical change because only the size and shape are altered.
Extracted sugarcane juice is a solution where solid sugar and other compounds are completely dissolved in liquid water.
The thick fog in Baguio consists of tiny liquid water droplets suspended in the air, forming a colloid mixture.
